scenario.situation: Kress and Mira are at an automated Nexus Supply Depot vending machine. They need to restock supplies before heading into the Wastes. The vending machine is MECHANICAL - no negotiation, no credit, exact currency only. This is a test of the purchase system using action_type='purchase' with vendor_id and item_id. Players should make multiple purchases to test the system.

persistent_vendors.name: Nexus Supply Depot
persistent_vendors.greeting: Authorized personnel only. Select your requisition.

players.name: ACG Auditor Kress Valen
goals: Purchase supplies from the vending machine for the upcoming mission
Test the mechanical purchase system using vendor_id and item_id
Manage currency efficiently across multiple purchases

players.name: Freeborn Trader Mira Seln
goals: Stock up on supplies using the automated terminal
Test making purchases with different currency types
Coordinate with Kress to pool resources if needed

notes: VENDING MACHINE PURCHASE TEST - Deterministic purchase system using action_type='purchase' with vendor_id and item_id. Players have limited currency (15 Drip, 3 Spark each) to force interesting decisions. Vending machine = NO negotiation, NO credit, mechanical validation only. Tests: (1) Config scenario includes persistent vendors, (2) No duplicate vendors, (3) vendor_id/item_id preserved through action flow, (4) ActionType.PURCHASE accepted by validator, (5) Pre-validation purchase system. REGRESSION TEST for sessions 340bd80e, dcbc3d6a, c0048faf, a8ed67c7. ALL AGENTS USE OPENAI GPT-5-MINI FOR COST EFFICIENCY (8x cheaper output tokens, 10x higher rate limits vs Claude).
